test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following states is the least urbanised state of India, as per the census of 2011?
solution:
The correct option is__** Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the census of 2011 **Himachal Pradesh** is the least urbanized state of India.
 
• Only **10.03% **of total population lives in urban areas.
 
• It is followed by** Bihar** with** 11.29%** of total population living in cities.
 
• **Tamil Nadu** continues to be the **most urbanized state** with **48.4%** of the population living in urban areas.
 
• **Mumbai** is the** most urbanized city **of India followed by **Delhi**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Bihar** is the most **densely populated state** whereas **Arunachal Pradesh** is the least.
 
• **Kerala** is having the highest **literacy rate**, on the other hand **Bihar** has the lowest.
 
• **Kerala** has the highest **sex ratio** in India and** Haryana** has the lowest.
 
• **Goa** has the** highest per capita income** among 33 Indian states and union territories.
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** is the** most populated** state of India.
